newsitem.title: CANADA: Ag Canada says wheat 23 pct of ag exports in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Ag Canada says wheat 23 pct of ag exports in 1995.

text.p: Canada exported C$17.3-billion worth of agricultural goods in calendar 1995, almost a quarter of which was wheat, an Agriculture Canada report stated.
Wheat made up Canada's largest agricultural export product in 1995, accounting for 23 percent of exports, Ag Canada said.
Livestock and meat was the second largest export category at 19 percent, followed by bakery, sugar and chocolate at 12 percent then bulk grains and oilseeds at 10 percent, it said.
Canola seed accounted for eight percent of exports as did fruits and vegetables while beverages and spirits made up six percent. Other products accounted for 14 percent of exports.

"The agriculture sector can be a major creator of wealth and jobs in Canada over the next 10 years. World agri-food trade is expected to grow by $150 billion over the next seven years alone," the Ag Canada report stated.
